decisions.name: Subject / Multi-Party
decisions.delta: Approve verified Subject issuer, canonical Person vs custodian Account, real business mandate and purpose/version scopes. Family/Team/Institution delegation and guardian approval remain separate.
decisions.compatibility: Native OIDC/PWS/R1 profile gate preserved. R4 exposes Business synthetic entry only.
decisions.boundary: Private access requires current native identity, synthetic Subject, accepted purpose/resource/version and membership; no new multi-party policy.
decisions.risk: Client adult/mandate declarations are not real verification.
decisions.local: Existing R3 gates reused; R4 rejects other private Subject paths.
decisions.tests: R4 20 contract / 11 browser; cross-account, role, source scope and non-Business denial.
decisions.external: Verified organization mandate/guardian and professional authority evidence before any real private sharing.
decisions.rollback: Disable R4 local entry; leave native R1/R2 and R3 records unchanged.
decisions.requestedChange: Reuse native PWS SUBJECT_CONTEXT_REF and account references. Keep Account, canonical Person, Subject, Membership, Workspace, Consent, Evidence and Entitlement distinct. Admit a versioned provisioning policy and purpose/resource/source-version grant mapping only after review. Local candidate has request→owner decision→invitation→independent acceptance; no automatic production grant.
decisions.humanDecision: Approve verified Subject issuer, canonical Person vs custodian Account, real business mandate and purpose/version scopes. Family/Team/Institution delegation and guardian approval remain separate.

decisions.name: Business Financial
decisions.delta: Admit a Business statement source shape, approved encrypted private source owner, custodian/delegation scopes, source freshness and review policy. Do not relabel Business as household.
decisions.compatibility: Existing calculateFinancialMetric requires household_id; existing draft/grant paths are personal. Native range-arithmetic reused; no second ledger or formula registry.
decisions.boundary: Parsed/validated is not reviewed. R4 refuses diagnosis until independently REVIEWED/RECONCILED; no real-data adapter entry.
decisions.risk: Company/sole-proprietor rules, profit/cash/withdrawal and monthly/quarterly comparison must stay distinct.
decisions.local: Actual R3 native source read/review/version + native financial arithmetic + typed summary; encrypted derived snapshot through native Context Owner.
decisions.tests: R4 source review/version, profit/cash unknown, exact source pin, delegated owner mismatch and historical drift.
decisions.external: Qualified financial/legal review and permitted real source documents. PDF case tax/insurance/estate recommendations are not endorsed.
decisions.rollback: Remove local R4 adapter entry; immutable R3 source and history retained.
decisions.requestedChange: Admit BUSINESS_STATEMENT_SOURCE under Financial with canonical Subject, custodian Account, legal form, reporting boundary, dates, basis, currency, reviewed source digest and field-level scope. Reuse existing PWS references and an approved private encrypted object Owner. No public upload path or additional accounting ledger.
decisions.humanDecision: Admit a Business statement source shape, approved encrypted private source owner, custodian/delegation scopes, source freshness and review policy. Do not relabel Business as household.

decisions.name: Subject Reading
decisions.delta: Approve exact Source Fact / Computed Metric / Interpretation / Scenario / Missing Evidence / Professional Review mappings and permitted customer output.
decisions.compatibility: Actual readRuntimeRuleFirst receives existing schema; financial source and computed strings remain reported, observedEvidence stays empty.
decisions.boundary: Native engine execution is not five-output semantic/publication admission.
decisions.risk: A source review is not professional judgment; scenarios are not forecasts.
decisions.local: Typed, source-version-bound compatibility context and native call implemented.
decisions.tests: R4 type separation, bilingual numeric/source identity and real UI.
decisions.external: Professional interpretation review if a regulated/advisory diagnosis is proposed.
decisions.rollback: Disable R4 mapping; existing Reading owner untouched.
decisions.requestedChange: Add an authorized Subject context/source mapping at the existing input Owner: Account, Subject type/ref/version, purpose/grant, evidence refs/versions, financial/process facts and Method applicability. Keep unreviewed financial input in reported experience; only actual dated public World evidence is observed. Never invent a parallel BFT Reading engine.
decisions.humanDecision: Approve exact Source Fact / Computed Metric / Interpretation / Scenario / Missing Evidence / Professional Review mappings and permitted customer output.

decisions.name: Navigation
decisions.delta: Admit Business reviewed source within an existing suitable family, precise source shape and purpose/delegated read contract. No SUBJECT source family.
decisions.compatibility: FINANCIAL source reader compatibility + actual native handoff. Native ownerId check preserved; reviewer is not rewritten as source owner.
decisions.boundary: Direction stays NOT_ESTABLISHED; human review options have implemented=false, actionOwner=null.
decisions.risk: Clicking a review prompt cannot become an action or full Navigation Path.
decisions.local: Actual FINANCIAL snapshot/handoff and explicit reconciliation choice.
decisions.tests: Native family/constraints, owner mismatch denial, no implementation or inferred direction.
decisions.external: Any real action needing financial/professional responsibility requires separate authority.
decisions.rollback: Disable injected local source reader; original FINANCIAL owner remains unchanged.
decisions.requestedChange: Keep the FINANCIAL family. Propose a versioned BUSINESS_STATEMENT source-reader branch with server-authorized Subject context; keep current PERSONAL draft resolver unchanged. Source identity/version, options, decision, approval, execution and observed outcome must remain separate.
decisions.humanDecision: Admit Business reviewed source within an existing suitable family, precise source shape and purpose/delegated read contract. No SUBJECT source family.

decisions.name: Continuity
decisions.delta: Approve Subject payload/identity, permitted private source references, retention/withdrawal, history pin/current-use rules, interrupted-write and cross-process recovery policy.
decisions.compatibility: Native encrypted NAVIGATION/ACCOUNT_CONTEXT primitive with existing SQLite tables and PWS references; payload stays a local policy candidate.
decisions.boundary: Same account + current resource/purpose/member authorization and expiry checked on every reopen. Changed source yields historical-only snapshot and current-use block.
decisions.risk: 7/30-day local proposal does not authorize production; global concurrency/recovery and withdrawal policy need formal approval.
decisions.local: Six concurrent requests → one native encrypted record; retry, restart, pending-write denial, audit, original-source pin and logout routing fixed.
decisions.tests: R4 native encryption/tamper/expiry/idempotency/restart/revocation and complete UI logout/login/reopen/review.
decisions.external: Cloud binding, retention/legal data lifecycle and controlled real-data QA after authorization.
decisions.rollback: Disable R4 local entry; no destructive purge or history rewrite.
decisions.requestedChange: Reuse the existing encrypted Context Owner and ACCOUNT_CONTEXT anchor, with Subject ref/version and immutable source refs in the payload. Native PWS stores a stable request reservation/reference; it is not a second history DB. Do not equate storage-owner execution with approved Continuity policy.
decisions.humanDecision: Approve Subject payload/identity, permitted private source references, retention/withdrawal, history pin/current-use rules, interrupted-write and cross-process recovery policy.
